body: Transfer window: after road access ends. Return copy to sender. Reverse: “Bread for Mother, no crust if it is still warm.”
title: Courier card with a late return
gloss: A courier's card sets a return after the access window.
rival_reading: A field-delivery schedule could run past a road restriction; the late return line does not identify who changed access.

body: The map routes past a checkpoint to the trial plots. A key tag says “sprayer pump.” In the margin, “wind turned at ten; east beans scorched by noon” is underlined twice.
title: The key marked for the last spray run
gloss: A spray route and a crop-damage note share the same marked key.
rival_reading: A response crew could reroute through farm roads during a closure; wind damage might be ordinary field loss rather than a program failure.
